name: Calendar
description: Mortar calendar: a month-grid date picker with keyboard navigation, min/max and unavailable dates, and an optional event list for the selected day. Dates are ISO strings, so no time zone shifts a day.

props.label: string
props.today: string (YYYY-MM-DD, required; the calendar never reads the clock)
props.events: CalendarEvent[] ({ id: string; date: string; title: string; time?: string; href?: string })

contract.usage: Import { Calendar } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
